verses.pali: “Dveme, bhikkhave, atthavase sampassamānā kiṁpurisā mānusiṁ vācaṁ na bhāsanti.
verses.english: “Aborigines see two reasons not to use regular speech.

verses.pali: Mā ca musā bhaṇimhā, mā ca paraṁ abhūtena abbhācikkhimhāti.
verses.english: Thinking: ‘May we not lie, and may we not misrepresent others with falsehoods.’

verses.pali: Ime kho, bhikkhave, dve atthavase sampassamānā kiṁpurisā mānusiṁ vācaṁ na bhāsantī”ti.
verses.english: Aborigines see these two reasons not to use regular speech.”
